For this proposed application, actor, owned face and selected helper bind to existing main_subject, primary_face and secondary_subject roles respectively; these deliberate application restrictions select existing entities rather than assigning arbitrary identity. The declared peer rival is already unmistakably adult in body and face presentation. Render visibly youthful-adult age presentation within that adult range, preserving declared adulthood and requester-owned identity without claiming biological age, a numeric age, or child or teen morphology.

The already declared peer-rival actor owns the haughty eyelids, brow, mouth and poised bearing; its face is explicitly part of that actor. No separately named counterpart is required for this common obligation.
Fresh youthful styling remains adult, with haughty half-lidded eyes and smug poised bearing readable on that rival.

The common adult peer, haughty smug poised baseline, fresh styling and visibly youthful-adult age presentation remain mandatory. No one-up, setback, warm crack or recovery is compulsory unless its explicit realization selects it; twin tails, small facial features, reference appearance or a label alone do not establish the archetype.
generic cuteness without haughty status play
a warm helpful scene with no smug rivalry

An already declared unmistakably adult peer rival has an already existing owned face with haughty half-lidded eyes, a smug poised facial baseline, poised bearing and fresh youthful adult styling. Render a visibly youthful-adult age presentation on the already adult actor; this changes visible age presentation only, without changing declared adulthood or claiming biological age, a numeric age, or child or teen morphology. The already declared peer-rival role is a prerequisite, without requiring a counterpart or second participant. For this proposed application, actor and owned face map to existing main_subject and primary_face roles; another unambiguous existing-owner application needs its own explicit owner map and guards. Four common component groups remain required; three incident groups remain independently optional. A one-up incident can be an already established scene context and is not created by this profile. Only a selected realization adds its stated event, local warmth cue or recovery beat.

이미 선언된 성인 또래 라이벌 역할과 그 인물에게 속한 기존 얼굴에 적용한다. 공통 profile은 상대역이나 두 번째 참여자를 요구하지 않는다. 이번 적용안은 인물·소유 얼굴·선택된 도움 제공자를 각각 기존 main_subject·primary_face·secondary_subject 역할에 대응시키며, 이는 임의 정체성을 부여하지 않고 기존 대상을 지정하는 명시적 적용 제한이다. 다른 명확한 기존 소유자 적용도 별도의 명시적 owner map과 guard를 통해 가능하다. 몸과 얼굴의 명백한 성인 표현을 보존한다. 기존 성인 인물의 외관상 연령 표현을 앳돼 보이는 성인으로 나타내되 선언된 성인 여부·생물학적 나이·수치 나이·아동이나 청소년의 체형을 바꾸거나 추론하지 않는다. 이어서 도도하게 반쯤 감긴 눈, 잘난 듯 침착한 얼굴 기본선과 도도하게 균형 잡힌 태도, 산뜻하고 젊은 성인의 차림을 유지하며 아동 같은 형태를 만들지 않는다. 우위를 뽐내는 사건은 선택적인 기존 장면 맥락으로서 이 기본선이 새로 만들 권한을 주지 않는다. 작은 차질이나 도움, 온기 틈, 태도 회복의 세 그룹은 독립적으로 선택하며 선택한 실현의 의무와 효과만 추가한다.

It does not establish actual skin temperature, a diagnosis, makeup pigment, or a private feeling, and it does not force mouth-corner softening.
The bounded cheek cue belongs to the same adult rival and remains separate from global grading, cosmetic pigment and claims about literal heat or emotion.
